books.title: The Beautiful Language of the Heart: Where evolution is inviting us to go
books.author: Anamika
books.description: Anamika follows Vaughn, who has nonspeaking autism, as he comes out of long isolation to find his own gifts and ways of communicating beyond speech. She uses his journey to look at connection, self-discovery and growing through pain, themes she sees in every life. A companion documentary is free to watch on her website.

left_out: Companion documentary (anamika.com/beautiful-language-heart): a film, not a teaching item; videos are handled separately. Mentioned in the book description instead.
